selection: Require the same rule and allocation to have at least eight trades and positive base, two-best-token removal and best-day removal returns across every price source, flow mode, history, population and execution scenario at 10% proceeds cost plus fees. At each drawdown ceiling maximize minimum return; break ties by higher drawdown bound, then lower rule ID and policy ID. A selected rule still needs exhaustive pair checks before promotion.
scope: Retrospective reuse of the existing 28-rule catalogue and two allocation policies. New swap prices stress all settings, including earlier failures. Vendor comparisons are reused from their audited source. The frozen prospective rules remain unchanged; these repeatedly examined trades are not independent validation.
